FLOWBOARD / WORKING BROWSER APPLICATION
Productivity01 / 06

Flowboard

A local-first task board with priority filters, search, stage changes and portable JSON exports.

Launch project ↗Source ↓
Behind the build

The challenge: keep a small workflow understandable without a complex account setup.

The implementation: explicit task state, safe text rendering, native controls and browser persistence.

Local-only task board; no team synchronisation or accounts.

The next step: user accounts, permissions and shared team workspaces.

DATA LENS / WORKING BROWSER APPLICATION
Data02 / 06

Data Lens

Drop in a CSV to explore means, medians, value distributions and a column-by-column statistical view.

Launch project ↗Source ↓
Behind the build

The challenge: make a raw spreadsheet understandable without sending it to a server.

The implementation: quoted-field parsing, numeric validation, descriptive statistics and browser-rendered charts.

Files are processed in your browser. Charts show the first 24 numeric values; no data is uploaded.

The next step: streaming larger datasets and richer chart controls.

ROUTE LAB / WORKING BROWSER APPLICATION
Algorithms03 / 06

Route Lab

Draw obstacles and watch BFS and DFS search for a route. Compare exploration and path length.

Launch project ↗Source ↓
Behind the build

The challenge: explain the difference between finding a route and finding a shortest route.

The implementation: graph traversal, parent reconstruction, cancellable animation and keyboard-operable cells.

Unweighted, four-directional grid. BFS finds a shortest path; DFS does not guarantee one.

The next step: weighted terrain and Dijkstra’s algorithm.

CONTRAST STUDIO / WORKING BROWSER APPLICATION
Design tools04 / 06

Contrast Studio

Live colour previews, contrast measurements, AA / AAA checks and ready-to-use CSS tokens.

Launch project ↗Source ↓
Behind the build

The challenge: give visual colour decisions a measurable readability check.

The implementation: sRGB luminance calculations, contrast thresholds and downloadable CSS variables.

Checks colour contrast only, not complete accessibility compliance. Normal-text AA threshold: 4.5:1.

The next step: multi-colour palette checks and automated page audits.

FOCUS STUDIO / WORKING BROWSER APPLICATION
Productivity05 / 06

Focus Studio

A focus timer with pause/resume, completion history and downloadable session records.

Launch project ↗Source ↓
Behind the build

The challenge: keep a session clock accurate when browser callbacks are delayed.

The implementation: wall-clock deadlines, explicit timer states and locally stored completed sessions.

Sessions are stored in this browser. No notifications, cloud sync or background alarms.

The next step: optional notifications and cross-device history.

Slotwise

Behind the build

The challenge: prevent overlapping appointments while keeping planning lightweight.

A single-person local planner. No live availability, shared bookings or email delivery.

The next step: time-zone-aware scheduling and shared availability.

ILLUSTRATIVE INTERFACE · NOT LIVE STUDENT DATA
Featured projectAI / Education

Student Dropout
Risk Prediction

A final-year project exploring AI-assisted identification of students at risk, with a focus on connecting early warning signals to timely academic support.

Explore the project

The challenge: Identifying academic difficulties early enough to offer meaningful help.

The approach: Combine predictive modelling with a student-focused support experience. Attendance, assessment performance and LMS activity form the intended early-warning signals.

The focus: Risk insights, support pathways and staff visibility. Developed as an academic project; institutional data access and live LMS integration require separate implementation and approval.

03 / A little about me

Logic meets
a creative instinct.

I’m Lefa, the developer behind Seloana Web Architects. I’m a final-year BSc Mathematical Sciences student at Sefako Makgatho Health Sciences University, majoring in Mathematics and Computer Sciences.

I enjoy the space where structured problem-solving meets thoughtful design. This portfolio brings that approach to life through six browser applications, business website work and an AI-focused final-year project in student success.
